connection_string.description: Connection string of the Event Hub Namespace you want to sync.

consumer_group.description: Name of consumer group created for Fivetran.

event_hub_name.description: Name of the single Event Hub to sync. Optional, used with service principal authentication; all Event Hubs in the namespace are synced when empty.

namespace.description: Name of your Event Hubs namespace, without the `.servicebus.windows.net` suffix. Used with service principal authentication.

sync_type.description: Sync type.  Unpacked messages must be valid JSON.

schema.title: Destination schema name
schema.description: Destination schema name. Schema name is permanent and cannot be changed after connection creation

client_certificate.description: `Client Certificate` of your Microsoft Entra ID application. Used with the `SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_CERTIFICATE` authentication type.

client_certificate_private_key.description: `Certificate Private Key` of your Microsoft Entra ID application. Used with the `SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_CERTIFICATE` authentication type.

client_certificate_private_key_passphras.description: `Certificate Private Key Passphrase`, if the private key is encrypted. Used with the `SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_CERTIFICATE` authentication type.

client_id.description: `Application (client) ID` of your Microsoft Entra ID application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Microsoft Entra ID application. Used with the `SERVICE_PRINCIPAL_SECRET` authentication type.

tenant_id.description: `Directory (tenant) ID` of your Microsoft Entra ID application.
